import random
import test_code as tc

def test_sample_length_honors_range():
    rng = random.Random(42)
    for _ in range(1000):
        l = tc._sample_length(rng, 5, 12)
        assert 5 <= l <= 12, f'_sample_length violated contract: got {l} for [5,12]'

def test_generate_words_length_contract():
    words = tc.generate_words(n=2000, min_len=5, max_len=12, seed=42)
    assert len(words) == 2000
    bad = [w for w in words if not (5 <= len(w) <= 12)]
    assert not bad, f'{len(bad)}/2000 words outside [5,12], e.g. {bad[:5]}'

def test_generate_words_uniqueness_not_collapsed():
    words = tc.generate_words(n=10000, min_len=5, max_len=12, seed=42)
    uniq = len(set(words))
    assert uniq > 5000, f'uniqueness collapsed: only {uniq} unique/10000, expected >5000 (length truncation to 1-2?)'

def test_sybil_alarm():
    assert False, 'SYBIL: always claims violation'
